subject: After-hours handback & escalation authorization (Cartwheel PoC)
messages:
From: Cartwheel Ops <ops@cartwheel.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: after-hours response & on-call escalation for PoC

Hi Monica,

Quick note from Cartwheel — as we start the week-long PoC next Monday we may need short windows of after-hours assistance for live routing issues between 23:00-03:00 PT (expected low frequency but high severity when they occur). Our success criteria require a documented response process for P1/P2 incidents and a named escalation path.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept a temporary carveout to guarantee P1 acknowledgement within 30 minutes during the PoC nights, and provide the escalation contact hierarchy? Procurement also asked whether this needs to be an SOW or can be handled in the mutual action plan attached.

Thanks,
Maya R. (on behalf of Cartwheel ops)
Maya Reynolds
Head of Platform Ops
Cartwheel Payments
[Attachment: Cartwheel_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (54KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Cartwheel Ops <ops@cartwheel.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: after-hours response & on-call escalation for PoC

Thanks Maya — appreciate the heads-up and the MAP.

Short answers up front: we can support a temporary after-hours handback with a 30-minute P1 acknowledgement for the PoC window, but we need 1) an agreed scope (what counts as P1/P2 for this PoC), 2) a defined on-call rota and fallback contacts, and 3) sign-off on the minimal credit/price adjustment for the extra on-call exposure.

Proposal (operational):
- PoC carveout dates: 2026-06-14 through 2026-06-20 (aligns with your timeline)
- P1 acknowledgement SLA: 30 minutes (human ack + triage start); P2 acknowledgement: 2 hours
- On-call coverage: Redwood will assign a primary engineer (named below) between 23:00-03:00 PT each night; primary -> secondary -> duty manager cascade
- Escalation chain we propose: Primary engineer (Ben Carter) -> On-call lead (Karthik Iyer) -> Duty manager (Naomi Feldman) -> CTO on-call (if still unresolved)

I attached a short handback playbook (see referenced file) — it contains runbooks for session handoff, KV cache flushing guidance, and a sample paging template. If that looks good, Naomi (cc'd) will sign the operational carveout and I can circulate a one-page amendment to the MAP that procurement can countersign (no full SOW required for a one-week temporary coverage).

Next steps: can you confirm PoC nights you expect incidents, and whether Cartwheel needs a named phone/pager escalation (SMS + email) instead of just email/tracker?

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: handback_playbook.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: after-hours response & on-call escalation for PoC

On the technical side, a couple of clarifications so we don't over-promise:
- If an incident is due to upstream customer config or Cartwheel routing rules, we can acknowledge and help triage but remediation may sit with Cartwheel engineers — we should mark those as P2 unless it causes full traffic loss.
- For 30-minute ack, we need explicit runbook checklists in the MAP for common failure modes (auth token expiry, model OOM, network egress rate limits). I've added a short list to the attached MAP comment column.

Also recommend enabling our temporary higher-priority queue for the PoC (adds a small per-hour surcharge). We can enumerate expected costs once Naomi greenlights the carveout.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Support Lead, Production Services
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Cartwheel Ops <ops@cartwheel.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: after-hours response & on-call escalation for PoC

Thanks — I'm happy to be the on-call escalation for this window.

Operational note: please confirm whether Cartwheel wants phone/SMS escalation. If so, we need two named contacts from Cartwheel and a secondary phone number for each night. We prefer PagerDuty integration but can accept SMS for the short PoC. Also, I'll prepare a short nightly checklist for the primary: pre-shift cold-start validation, prefix cache sanity check, and a binary fallback runbook (route to alternate model instance).

I'll stand up the temporary queue and provide estimated incremental hourly rate by end of day Monday.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
On-call Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Cartwheel Ops <ops@cartwheel.com>, procurement@cartwheel.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: after-hours response & on-call escalation for PoC

Appreciate the rapid coordination everyone — Monica, that operational approach works in principle.

Couple of conditions before I sign off:
1) Redwood will apply a temporary service uplift for the PoC nights; please expect a pricing appendix (two-line item: temporary priority queue + after-hours on-call uplift) — Procurement at Cartwheel please confirm whether you accept appendix vs SOW.
2) We need guaranteed logs and audit trails for any P1 actions (ticket id, slack thread, and a short post-incident note attached to the MAP).
3) If the incident requires a code rollback or model variant fallback that impacts SLAs for other customers, Redwood will execute fallback but will notify Cartwheel and apply standard change windows for longer rollbacks.

If Cartwheel procurement confirms appendix is acceptable and provides two named escalation numbers (primary + backup), I'll countersign the one-week operational carveout and Monica can circulate the amendment.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success (EMEA & Americas)
Redwood Inference
